pkgmetadata.longdescription: QindaTK is a Qt 6 / QML toolkit for dense desktop interfaces: CSS flexbox and grid layout containers, absolute stacks, box model and overflow scrolling, a measured dense theme with density modes, Lucide icons, a zone/lane docking model, and dense controls. It installs the QindaTK QML module, the qindatk shared library with CMake package config, the QindaTK.QindaQt token bridge, and the qtk-preview tool.

use.flag: Real Linux PCM devices for the audio engine via media-libs/alsa-lib (built-in silent devices otherwise)
Native print backend (Qt PrintSupport) with CUPS job submission via net-print/cups
Media decode, compositing input and encode via media-video/ffmpeg
PDF page rendering via app-text/poppler (Qt 6 bindings)
Let qtk-preview render under installed QindaQt desktop themes (--qst) via gui-wm/qindaqt-desktop; that package depends on qindatk, so disable this for a first install
Qt Quick 3D renderers (SceneView3D, material and 3D plot views) via dev-qt/qtquick3d
qindatk_widgets adapters (native file dialog) via Qt Widgets
